Our mission is to build a **supportive** and **inclusive** community where students, researchers, and professionals can **grow their geospatial skills together**. 🌱

# Want to **join** our Geospatial Share workshops?

We run **monthly skill sharing tutorial sessions** where a member of our community teaches us something they have learned along the way.

Fill out [this form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeXfv6EPzm6ur5e9IrDPK07e5N1y2xxYNQlBe_xutTDu-ajBw/viewform) to join and get the workshop link:

## Upcoming Workshop {style="padding-top: 5px;"}

### Modelling Koala Distribution Under Different Climate Scenarios

**Who**: Charlotte Patterson (QUT), Scott Forrest (QUT, CSIRO)

**When**: Wed April 16, 2:30-4:40 pm AEST

**Where**: Hybrid - QUT Gardens Point campus R310 OR Teams ([join our mailing list](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeXfv6EPzm6ur5e9IrDPK07e5N1y2xxYNQlBe_xutTDu-ajBw/viewform) for the link)

**Description**:

Ahead of the ICCB workshop, GeoSpatial Share group are getting a sneak peak of a session on modeling koala distribution using species distribution models (SDMs), covering SDM basics, data access, and model validation. The session will also address challenges like presence-only records and SDM algorithm comparisons.

Find out more and join the workshop [here](posts/2025-04-08-apr-newsletter/).
